headline: US Senator Lindsey Graham has died at 71
summary: The prominent Republican Senator from South Carolina passed away on Saturday evening following a sudden illness.
details: US Senator Lindsey Graham, a prominent Republican from South Carolina, has died at the age of 71. He passed away on Saturday evening after falling suddenly ill.
The news was confirmed in a post on X by the public relations officer of Graham's office on Sunday morning.
Graham was elected to the US Senate in 2002 and previously served in the US House of Representatives starting in 1994, representing South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District.
Known as a hawk on defense, his official website stated that he consistently pushed for results in the war on terror to protect America's long-term national security interests.
Throughout his career, he served as chairman of the Senate Budget Committee and was a member of the Senate Appropriations, Judiciary, and Environment and Public Works committees.
While he began his political career as a staunch critic of Donald Trump, he later became one of the President's most trusted allies in Capitol Hill.
caption:
US Senator Lindsey Graham has passed away at 71 after a sudden illness.

US Senator Lindsey Graham, a prominent Republican from South Carolina, has died at the age of 71. He passed away on Saturday evening after falling suddenly ill.

The news was confirmed in a post on X by the public relations officer of Graham's office on Sunday morning.

Graham was elected to the US Senate in 2002 and previously served in the US House of Representatives starting in 1994, representing South Carolina's 3rd Congressional District.

Known as a hawk on defense, his official website stated that he consistently pushed for results in the war on terror to protect America's long-term national security interests.

Throughout his career, he served as chairman of the Senate Budget Committee and was a member of the Senate Appropriations, Judiciary, and Environment and Public Works committees.

While he began his political career as a staunch critic of Donald Trump, he later became one of the President's most trusted allies in Capitol Hill.

headline: 79,246 students award primary scholarships in Bangladesh
summary: Girls make up nearly 55% of the recipients, with 32,965 students securing talent-pool scholarships.
details: Education Minister ANM Ehsanul Hoque Milon announced that 79,246 Class five students have secured talent-pool and general scholarships under the Primary Scholarship Examination 2025.
Girls showed strong performance, accounting for 43,354 recipients, or 54.71 percent, while boys secured 35,892 awards, or 45.29 percent.
The breakdown includes 32,965 talent-pool scholarships and 46,281 general scholarships.
Among talent-pool recipients, 26,375 are from government primary schools and 6,590 from private schools.
General scholarship recipients include 36,420 from government primary schools and 9,861 from private schools.
A total of 645,041 students registered for the exam, but only 419,982 (65.11 percent) actually sat for the test.
Of the total examinees, 60.32 percent were girls and 39.68 percent were boys.
caption:
Nearly 80,000 students just secured primary scholarships! Girls leading with 55% of the awards.

Education Minister ANM Ehsanul Hoque Milon announced that 79,246 Class five students have secured talent-pool and general scholarships under the Primary Scholarship Examination 2025.

Girls showed strong performance, accounting for 43,354 recipients, or 54.71 percent, while boys secured 35,892 awards, or 45.29 percent.

The breakdown includes 32,965 talent-pool scholarships and 46,281 general scholarships.

Among talent-pool recipients, 26,375 are from government primary schools and 6,590 from private schools.

General scholarship recipients include 36,420 from government primary schools and 9,861 from private schools.

A total of 645,041 students registered for the exam, but only 419,982 (65.11 percent) actually sat for the test.

Of the total examinees, 60.32 percent were girls and 39.68 percent were boys.
